overview: “Kashmir is known for its natural beauty, with lush green valleys, snow-capped mountains, and scenic lakes. The region is often referred to as "Paradise on Earth" due to its picturesque landscapes. Some of the popular tourist attractions in Kashmir include the Dal Lake, the Mughal gardens, and the Gulmarg meadow. Additionally, the region is also known for its handicrafts and traditional woolen shawls, which are popular souvenirs among visitors.

days.title: ARRIVAL SRINAGAR LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
days.body: Upon your arrival our driver/travel guide will meet you at the Srinagar Airport. Following a quick introduction, and start your stay. You'll delight in exploring Srinagar. It is one of the most beautiful city in the nation. However, the sight of increased security outside the airport greets you as soon as you land. Don't forget to tour the Mughal Gardens. You'll get the impression that things are just like they would be in any other city, with everyone occupied with their jobs

days.title: SONAMARG DAY TRIP
days.body: Enjoy your early breakfast, then get ready for a day of exploration. You will be driven to Sonamarg by your private chauffeur. You can reach Sonamarg, known for its glaciers and trekking, after a twohour journey. To get to the glacier, you must employ ponies. Visit Fish Point in Sonamarg for a zorbing ball ride and small boat ride as well. In Sonamarg, white water rafting and trekking are a necessity if you enjoy the water and heights.

days.title: GULMARG DAY TRIP
days.body: Get up early, fuel up with a hearty meal and begin your day by visiting Gulmarg. A stop at Kongdoori and Afarwat is included in the Gondola ride in Gulmarg, which is one of the highest cable rope cars in the world. You will be fascinatedby the glaciersin Khilanmerg & Afarwat, And they willleave an Impression On your memories. Enjoy Snow Ski in Gulmarg with a knowledgeable Ski guide. After a full day of entertainment, relax to your hotel room for the night.

days.title: DHOOD PATHRI DAY TRIP
days.body: The history of this location is very fascinati ng. It is known for its rolling hills, meadows, and streams of crystal-clear water. When the swiftly moving water hits the stones, it takes on a milky appearance. This may be the origin of the name “Doodpathri" for this location. The name does, literally mean "the valley of milk" (doodh means milk and pathri means valley). Doodhpathri is a beautiful valley hidden away for the usual tourist map. It offers splendid views and sceneries along with a beautiful river that flows across and short trek for those interested.

days.title: SRINAGAR TO PAHALGHAM
days.body: After being picked up, proceed to Pahalgam. You will be driven to Pahalgham by your private chauffeur. Two hours of driving will bring you to Pahalgham. You can stop at the Saffron fields and Awantipora Ruins on your way there. The Awantipora ruins are a collection of historic Hindu temples that King Avantivarman (AD 855–883) constructed when he made the location his capital. Check into your hotel and get ready for a day trip to Kashmir, the home of Bollywood. The magnificence of the River Lidder will fascinate you. Return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and the cosines of your bed while enjoying the priceless memories

days.title: PAHALGHAM TO SRINAGAR
days.body: Enjoy your breakfast, then get ready for a day of exploring the valley. The magnificence of Betaab Valley, Chandanwari, and Aru Valley will mesmerize you. A trip to Baisaran Valley is essential if you wish to ride ponies. (Separate Cab Required). The magnificence of the River Lidder will fascinate you. Pahalgam Club, a children's park, a zoo, and a golf club are further attractions. Return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and the cosines of your bed while enjoying the priceless memories

days.title: DROP SRINAGAR AIRPORT
days.body: Take pleasure in an early breakfast before getting ready while thinking fondly about Kashmir. You would be taken to Srinagar by your private chauffeur
